en: Sepia-toned photograph of a cloister-like garden courtyard enclosed by tall, ivy-covered brick buildings. Large multi-pane windows line the inner facades, and a gravel path forms a cross-shaped layout through dense shrubs, flowers, and small trees. A single figure in dark, long clothing, possibly a nun or monk, stands near the center-right of the courtyard. The image has the aged look and border wear typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No visible printed caption or text appears on the front.
